description: This file defines an Orleans grain class ImplicitSubscription_TransientError_RecoverableStream_CollectorGrain, which is used for testing fault injection and recovery mechanisms in streaming scenarios. It includes logic for fault injection at various points during stream processing, handles stream subscription, and manages state for testing resilience.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscription_TransientError_RecoverableStream_CollectorGrain
classes.description: An Orleans Grain class designed for testing fault injection and recovery in stream processing, including mechanisms for fault injection at specific points, stream subscription management, and state checkpointing.

classes.name: FireOnNthTry
classes.description: A helper class to trigger a fault only on a specific attempt number.

classes.name: FaultsState
classes.description: Houses multiple FireOnNthTry instances to inject faults at different stages of stream processing.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic, establishes stream subscription, and initializes fault states.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Processes incoming stream events, manages state, logs progress, checkpoints, and triggers faults as configured.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error events, logs errors.

methods.name: InjectFault
methods.description: Triggers a fault injection, optionally deactivates the grain to simulate failure and restart.

methods.name: InjectFault (overloaded)
methods.description: Injects a fault, with additional context on whether the activation is occurring or not.
